annotations.title: imagepeek: rotate or flip an image

description: imagepeek: Rotate or flip an image. To change the format use image_convert. Returns the image rotated clockwise by `angle` (multiples of 90 are lossless transposes; other angles are bicubic, expanded by default, corners filled with `background`) and/or flipped (horizontal, vertical, both). Reads PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF, TIFF, BMP, ICO and AVIF; other formats and images over 40 megapixels are refused (not charged). Output: base64 `data_base64`, without EXIF, GPS, XMP or IPTC; over 15 MB or 50 megapixels is a 413 (not charged). Images are not logged; a result is kept only with `output` "url" (24 h). Typically 0.5-2 s. Price: USD 0.002. Free: 3 imagepeek calls per IP per UTC day. Docs: https://tanod.dev/learn/image-rotate-api.html

background.description: Fill for uncovered corners: #rrggbb[aa] or transparent (default transparent, or white without alpha).
background.title: Background

expand.description: Grow the canvas to hold the whole rotated image (default true); false keeps the size and clips the corners.
expand.title: Expand

flip.description: Mirror after rotating: none (default), horizontal, vertical or both.
flip.title: Flip

format.description: Output format (default: the input's; ICO in, PNG out).
format.title: Format

image_base64.description: The image as standard or url-safe base64 (at most 10 MB decoded; a data:image/...;base64, prefix is fine); or use url.
image_base64.title: Image Base64

output.description: base64 (default): inline. url: stored for 24 hours; link, metadata.
output.title: Output

url.description: Public http(s) URL of the image (at most 10 MB; private, internal and IP-literal hosts are refused); or use image_base64.
url.title: Url

name: image_rotate
